:::{#exm-matrix-rows-columns}
#### Rows and columns of a matrix

For $\matr{A} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 5 & 6 \end{bmatrix}$,
the [rows](#def-matrix-row) are
$\matr{A}_{1,:} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 & 3 \end{bmatrix}$
and
$\matr{A}_{2,:} = \begin{bmatrix} 4 & 5 & 6 \end{bmatrix}$,
and the [columns](#def-matrix-column) are
$\matr{A}_{:,1} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 4 \end{bmatrix}$,
$\matr{A}_{:,2} = \begin{bmatrix} 2 \\ 5 \end{bmatrix}$
and
$\matr{A}_{:,3} = \begin{bmatrix} 3 \\ 6 \end{bmatrix}$.
